tasks.short: Locate fires from azimuths and landmarks

steps.what: Identify the actual observation station, known landmarks and current area map for locating the forest fire.
inputs: Actual station, landmarks and area map
outputs: Actual map reference and observation position

steps.what: Use the actual azimuth sighter to observe the fire or smoke bearing and distinguish the relevant plume from landmarks and other smoke.
inputs: Actual station and references from s1
outputs: Actual sighted bearing and uncertainty

steps.what: Enter the actual observation position, bearing, bearing reference and time in the existing map plotting tool, including uncertainty and any actual second bearing.
outputs: Actual supplied bearing inputs for plotting

steps.what: Plot the supplied azimuth line on the area map and calculate an intersection only where actual independent bearings exist, using the map tool's native geometry.
inputs: Current georeferenced area map from s1
outputs: Draft bearing line or actual supported intersection, with uncertainty

steps.what: Check the plotted location against the actual known landmarks, terrain and sighting uncertainty, correcting the inputs or retaining only a bearing corridor if a point location is unsupported.
outputs: Actual defensible fire-location mark or uncertain bearing corridor

steps.what: Keep the checked location mark in the same actual map session.
outputs: Retained actual location mark

tasks.design: Use existing native map geometry for the manual line plotting, not a vision model or autonomous dispatch. OTHER means the actual azimuth sighter and existing geospatial map application. Field observation and input capture are explicit; one bearing remains a corridor, not an invented fire point.
tasks.previous_blocker: Transferring a sighted azimuth onto a map can require manual ruler work or manual line drawing.
tasks.enabler_now: A native geospatial bearing tool can place a line from a supplied station and bearing.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong station, reference north or smoke identification yields a precise-looking wrong line.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret actual sight lines and terrain before treating a map mark as a fire location.

ambition.what: Locate the same observed fire with the existing evidence.

evidence.claim: Native geospatial tools can plot supplied azimuth lines without acquiring the actual sighting.

assumptions: Conditional baseline manually plots actual bearings and already has a compatible electronic area map; estimated shares need observation.
No drone, sensor, second observer or second bearing is supplied for free.
No dispatch or additional fire report is added to this location task.
unknowns: Actual map compatibility and current plotting method
research_questions: Compare the actual bearing reference and plotted line against a known landmark before configuring the tool.

already_counted.description: Actual map reference, sighting, input capture, terrain check and ordinary retention

incremental.description: Check station coordinates and bearing-reference configuration after map changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conservative case has an incompatible or paper-only area map, so actual manual plotting continues and no new setup is adopted. With a compatible map and actual manual line work, only the 20-hour geometry step is removed, less 1 hour configuration checking. Actual sighting, input capture and uncertainty assessment remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the actual assigned patrol area, access conditions and weather constraints before entering the forest patrol route.
inputs: Actual patrol assignment and current access/weather conditions
outputs: Actual patrol approach within the assignment

steps.what: Patrol the actual assigned areas, looking for forest fires, hazardous conditions and weather phenomena from the ground and actual available vantage points.
outputs: Actual patrol observations or areas not safely accessible

steps.what: Assess the actual observed smoke, vegetation hazards and weather changes and decide whether to continue, investigate locally or stop the patrol under the actual field procedure.
outputs: Actual patrol response decision

tasks.design: Retain the physical patrol and actual observation. OTHER means actual field navigation and observation equipment. Native map routing or a weather display may support access, but no duplicate map compilation, written patrol report or routine notification is established in this task. Do not invent one to create a saving, and do not substitute unprovided drone coverage for field work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hazards can be local, concealed and absent from existing map or weather layers.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing navigation information may help the inspector but no changed action is established.
tasks.still_hard: Ground access, fresh smoke and changing weather must be judged at the actual site.
tasks.human_edge: Investigate ambiguous conditions and recognise the limits of safe access.
tasks.altitude: Understand the coverage and blind spots of the assigned patrol.

evidence.claim: A navigation display cannot itself replace ground observation of new hazards.

assumptions: No distinct manual written report, re-key or scheduled send is evidenced for this patrol; none is added.
This is active patrol time, not a baseline padded with unattended weather-feed runtime.
No reduction is transferred to a sibling task.
unknowns: Actual patrol method and any real duplicate record work
research_questions: Observe an actual patrol to determine whether a separately timed record or dispatch action exists.

already_counted.description: Actual preparation, physical patrol and local hazard judgement

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The actual preparation, looking and response decision remain. After considering native route and weather displays, no existing duplicate written output or send is evidenced and no physical observation can be removed. No extra recording duty or speculative remote sensor coverage is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual temperature, humidity, wind direction and velocity instruments and observe the actual cloud formations at the observation site.
inputs: Actual site instruments and sky conditions
outputs: Actual weather measurements and cloud observations

steps.what: Capture the actual readings, observation times, station and instrument units in the weather worksheet {SPREADSHEET}, including suspect readings and missing values.
outputs: Actual supplied numerical weather rows and observation notes

steps.what: Compile the actual temperature, relative-humidity and wind entries into the required observation-period table using native {SPREADSHEET} filters and the actual report's specified numerical rules.
inputs: Actual supplied weather rows from s2
outputs: Draft compiled numerical weather table with missing-value flags

steps.what: Classify the actual observed cloud formations and describe unusual weather or instrument problems for the report, keeping uncertainty explicit.
inputs: Actual sky observations and instrument concerns from s1-s2
outputs: Actual cloud classification and weather exception text

steps.what: Place the actual compiled table and inspector-written cloud and exception text into the existing meteorological report layout in {DOCS} using native linked fields.
inputs: Actual cloud and exception text from s4
outputs: Complete draft meteorological report

steps.what: Check the completed meteorological report's actual observation periods, units, values, clouds and omissions; correct it and authorise the final version and actual recipient for sending.
inputs: Actual source readings and observations from s1-s2
outputs: Checked final weather report and version/recipient send authorisation

steps.what: Save the checked final meteorological report in the same {DOCS} working record.
outputs: Saved final weather report

steps.what: Send the actual final weather report to its authorised recipient through {EMAIL}, bound to the checked version and recipient from s6.
outputs: Actual sent meteorological report

tasks.design: Use native worksheet compilation and native report field links. Actual instrument reading, capture, sky classification and final checking stay with the inspector. OTHER is the actual weather instrumentation, not an unprovided automated feed. Changes to values, report or recipient rerun compilation as needed and invalidate the send authorisation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same actual weather rows may be manually arranged into period tables and copied into the report.
tasks.enabler_now: Native worksheet filters, formulae and linked report fields can do the exact compilation and assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Observation quality, missing values and cloud identification require actual field judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise implausible instruments and describe the actual sky rather than infer it from numbers.

ambition.what: Produce the actual existing weather report.

tasks.altitude: Specify the report's numerical rules and missing-observation handling.

evidence.claim: Native worksheet compilation and document links can remove manual numerical arrangement and copying without automating actual weather observation.

assumptions: Conditional workflow already captures actual readings in an electronic worksheet and manually compiles and sends a report; estimated shares are unmeasured.
The 25-hour compilation is actual manual work, not elapsed sensor runtime or existing automatic calculation.
Manual repair of missing or anomalous readings and linked-output checks remains in s2, s4 and s6.
unknowns: Actual period definitions, wind representation and current report-generation features
research_questions: Replay an actual reporting period including missing readings and check the native output against the current manual report.

already_counted.description: Actual measurements, capture, cloud judgement, final report checking, save and send

incremental.description: Maintain period definitions and verify worksheet-to-report mappings

approvals.approved_version: Final weather report and recipient checked in s6; any change requires s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case retains the full 25-hour numerical compilation because mixed units and irregular observation periods cannot yet use the configured rules, but the compatible final report layout still removes the 10-hour copy step; less 2 hours upkeep leaves 8. The compatible full case removes both exact compilation and copy steps, 35 hours less 2. Actual capture, classification and complete final checking remain in both cases.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Physically examine and count the actual axes, hoses, shovels, pumps, buckets and extinguishers, determining each item's condition and actual availability.
inputs: Actual firefighting equipment and inspection criteria
outputs: Actual equipment quantities and condition findings

steps.what: Enter the actual equipment counts and condition findings in the existing inventory {OPS_SYSTEM}; native item selection supplies repeated description and unit fields only.
inputs: Actual quantities and findings from s1
outputs: Actual entered item quantities and condition records

steps.what: Total the actual entered equipment quantities by type and recorded condition using the inventory system's native summary view {OPS_SYSTEM}.
outputs: Draft equipment quantity and condition totals

steps.what: Reconcile the actual inventory totals and condition entries against the examined equipment, correcting missing items, duplicates and uncertain condition entries in {OPS_SYSTEM}.
inputs: Actual inspection and item entries from s1-s2
outputs: Actual reconciled equipment inventory

steps.what: Save the reconciled inventory in the same {OPS_SYSTEM} record.
outputs: Saved actual equipment inventory

tasks.design: Use native equipment selection and quantity summaries in the existing inventory. OTHER is actual field inspection equipment. Keep all counting and physical condition work; neither a barcode nor a dropdown proves condition. The inventory itself is explicit in the task; no separate trailing report or procurement action is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated descriptions and manual totals can coexist with manual physical inspection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item lists and summaries remove only those repeated fields and arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment can be present but damaged, incomplete or unavailable.
tasks.human_edge: Determine actual usable condition by physical examination.
tasks.altitude: Specify clear equipment identity and condition categories.

evidence.claim: Inventory item defaults and native totals do not replace actual equipment counts or condition examination.

assumptions: Conditional baseline has an actual equipment inventory with manual repeated description fields and manual totals; shares are estimates.
Only 15% of the entry step is repeated metadata; new quantities and findings remain.
No new physical tag programme or free clean equipment master is assumed; unsuitable items remain manually entered.
unknowns: Current equipment identifiers, master quality and existing totals
research_questions: Time an actual inventory round and determine which repeated fields and totals are genuinely manual.

already_counted.description: Physical examination, new fact entry, reconciliation and ordinary save

incremental.description: Maintain actual equipment item descriptions and native summary categories

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conservative case is an already-totalled inventory or an inconsistent equipment list where descriptions must still be entered manually, so no change is deployed. In the eligible case, 3 hours of repeated metadata plus 10 hours of manual totals are removed, less 1 hour upkeep. The actual equipment examination and new condition data remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Maintain sound field evidence and explicit map, weather and inventory rules while retaining actual inspection and patrol.
skills_to_grow: Equipment identity and condition data quality
role.ambitious_version: An inspector who uses exact native calculations and reusable forms while keeping actual forest observations and equipment judgement.

job.title: Forest Fire Inspectors and Prevention Specialists
